prompt: Single continuous shot. A cleaver splitting a whole squash with one decisive crack, deep orange flesh revealed. Cubes tumble into a pot where onion and ginger sizzle, broth poured over with rising steam. Money shot: the blended soup pouring back into the pot in a thick velvet ribbon, swirling into the chunky half, steam backlit gold. Final beat: a bowl served, olive oil drizzled in a spiral, pumpkin seeds scattering, hands wrapping around the warm bowl. Warm light, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: the squash crack, then the velvet pour. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
caption:
Sopa de abóbora que abraça — cremosa sem creme de leite.
🧾 1/2 abóbora cabotiá · 1 cebola · 2 dentes de alho · 1 dedo de gengibre · caldo de legumes
1. Refoga cebola, alho e gengibre. 2. Abóbora em cubos + caldo até cobrir — 20 min. 3. Bate METADE no liquidificador e volta pra panela.
💡 Bater só metade dá cremosidade E textura — sopa toda batida vira papinha. Salva pra próxima noite fria 📌
